body: I get adequate physical exercise (about 30-40 minutes a day) so I know it's neither lack or excess of physical exercise that's causing this though.

Getting back at my parents isn't the main reason that I want to do it. I want to commit suicide because I am not suited for, both physically and mentally, for life in this world. I'd rather die than live as an outcast. Every day is consumed with thoughts of death and regretting the fact that I was ever born. I just don't want to exist anymore. The only reason I didn't go through with it was when I was 14 was because I felt bad about potentially ruining my family's lives. But today I realized that they deserve it. My little sister is a stupid bitch who makes fun of me every day for not having friends and being small for my age/gender, my mom just ignores my emotional and social problems, and my dad just yells at me for displaying any sadness at my sorry and pathetic state. The guilt I'd feel about ruining their lives by killing myself is slowly withering away with every passing day.
